bioconda.name: oxo-call
bioconda.summary: Model-intelligent orchestration for CLI bioinformatics — call any tool with LLM intelligence
bioconda.description: oxo-call is an AI-powered CLI assistant for bioinformatics. Instead of  memorizing hundreds of flags across dozens of tools, you describe what  you want to accomplish — oxo-call translates that into a correct, grounded command.
